subject: POC next steps & RACI - Lumos Health trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alison Green <alison.green@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@lumoshealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + POC next steps (success criteria & RACI)

Hi Alison / Ravi -

Thanks again for the demo today - great conversation. As promised, a short recap and proposed next steps so we can align on success criteria and clearly assign owners for the POC. I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a one-page success criteria doc.

High-level POC scope (recap)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference performance (latency, cost per token) and integration with Lumos patient search workflow for the billing team.
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week integration + 2-week evaluation).
- Test load: 1000 queries/day average, peaks to 3000/day for 30-minute windows.

Proposed success criteria (draft)
1) Latency: 95th percentile <= 450ms for 512-token context during peak test windows.
2) Cost: <= $X per 1M tokens (we'll refine once we agree model/quantization).
3) Accuracy: extraction/formatting fidelity >= 92% on a 200-case test set you'll provide.
4) Reliability: SLA-style availability >= 99.5% during the evaluation window.

Ownership / initial RACI ask (draft)
- Lumos infra (VPC, routing, firewall rules): Lumos infra team (we need a primary contact).
- App integration (API calls, data transforms): Lumos app owner / engineering (Alison to confirm).
- Security review & questionnaire: Lumos security + Redwood security (we'll complete SOC2 evidence).
- Procurement / contracting: Lumos procurement (Ravi looped).
- Redwood technical lead for POC: Marissa Cole (me) - infra & security handoffs to be assigned to our infra SEs.

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the Lumos POC owner(s) for infra, app, security, and procurement?
2) If the scope above looks right, we'll finalize the MAP and schedule an onboarding call with our infra engineer.
3) Please share the 200-case test set or a sampling by EOD next Tuesday if possible.

Attachments: Lumos_POC_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, POC_success_criteria.md

Thanks - I'll send a version of the MAP with the RACI filled per your replies.

-
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alison Green <alison.green@lumoshealth.com>

Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@lumoshealth.com>, Lumos Health Procurement <procurement@lumoshealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + POC next steps (success criteria & RACI)

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick answers below and a couple of questions from our side.

Confirmed internal owners (initial):
- Infra / networking: Dev Patel (dev_patel@lumoshealth.com) - will own VPC peering, routes, and firewall rules.
- App integration / data: Alison Green (me) - will own API integration and validation with billing search.
- Security / compliance: Sana Iqbal (sana.iqbal@lumoshealth.com) - she'll send our standard questionnaire to you.
- Procurement / contract: Ravi Menon - procurement lead on cc.

Questions / notes:
- Can Redwood support private VPC peering for the POC or do you require a VPN? Our security prefers VPC peering if supported.
- For the 200-case test set: we can provide a de-identified CSV by next Tuesday but need confirmation on data handling and retention during the POC.

I'll loop Sana in on the questionnaire once we coordinate offline with your security team. Otherwise the scope and criteria look good - please update the MAP with the RACI table and next-step dates and we'll sign off.

Best,
Alison
Director, Product - Billing | Lumos Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alison Green <alison.green@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@lumoshealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + POC next steps (success criteria & RACI)

Thanks Alison - this is perfect. Quick answers and an ask to our internal team.

1) VPC peering: Yes, we can support VPC peering for the POC. I've flagged infra to prepare a peering checklist (routing, CIDR validation, security groups).
2) Data handling: We will treat the test set as PII-sensitive. For the POC we will:
   - Require de-identified data (preferred) or tokenized PHI if de-id not possible.
   - Auto-delete data from Redwood staging within 30 days of POC completion unless you request otherwise.
   - Provide an evidence package for data handling and SOC2 mappings.

Internal ask: Dev / Lauren - can one of you own the peering onboarding and security questionnaire coordination? Recommended assignments:
- Dev Patel: lead on VPC peering + infra setup (peering checklist, sample Terraform if needed).
- Lauren Bishop: own security questionnaire + evidence packaging (SOC2 artifacts, retention policy, access logs).

Proposed timeline (once MAP signed):
- Week 0-1: VPC peering, onboarding, test dataset ingest (integration team).
- Week 2-3: Evaluation (run test set, capture latency/cost metrics).
- Week 4: Wrap-up review + scoring against success criteria.

I'll update the MAP and send a version with the RACI filled using the owners above.

-
Marissa
